# .github/solar-system/

This directory is the **SOLAR-Ralph isolated self-improvement boundary**.

## What belongs here

| Subdirectory   | Generated by installer | Purpose                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `adversarial/` | Yes (Step 5H)          | Adversarial trigger conditions + injection pattern checklist (`skeleton-manifest.md`)            |
| `protocols/`   | Yes (Step 5H)          | `inquiry-first.md` + `lifecycle-coordination.md` — lifecycle and gate protocols                  |
| `schemas/`     | Yes (Step 5H)          | 6 typed handoff JSON schemas for inter-agent output contracts (empty envelopes)                  |
| `learnings/`   | No — Optional          | Learning capture files. Active when `"learning": true` in `solar.config.json`. Empty by default. |
| `logs/`        | No — Optional          | Per-session activity log files. Active when `"logging": true` in `solar.config.json`.            |

## What does NOT belong here

- Project-facing instructions (`*.instructions.md`) — those live in `.github/instructions/`
- Active ledger state — that lives in `.github/.ai_ledger.md`
- Agent definitions (`*.agent.md`) — those live in `.github/agents/`
- Hook scripts (`*.cjs`) — those live in `.github/hooks/`
- Prompt commands (`*.prompt.md`) — those live in `.github/prompts/`

## Isolation Rule

Files in `solar-system/` are **SOLAR-internal** and must never be referenced in:

- Project-facing `copilot-instructions.md`
- Non-SOLAR story or epic documentation
- Agent delegation for non-SOLAR tasks

The governor and specialist agents may reference these files during SOLAR setup,
self-improvement, and governance operations only.

## History

- Phase 1 of SOLAR-Ralph v4 implementation (2026-04-04)
- Thinned to template-only state: April 2026 — removed session artifacts and redundant files
- Aligned to base install spec: April 2026 — `context/` and `patterns/` removed; `session-resumption.md`, `handoff-types.md`, `workflow-metadata.schema.json` moved to `docs/knowledge-base/` as v4 reference
